scheduled_jobs.description: Upserts weekly draft FundRequest for the upcoming Mon-Sun.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: fund_requests.services.regenerate() upserts by (week, owner) — safe to re-run.
scheduled_jobs.name: weekly_fund_request

scheduled_jobs.description: Generates next month's MonthlyWorkPlanBudget draft envelope.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: update_or_create keyed on (country_id, month_key) — safe to re-run.
scheduled_jobs.name: monthly_work_plan

scheduled_jobs.description: Escalates stale action-required notifications past a 48h SLA.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Re-running only re-escalates already-urgent rows to the same state — no-op on repeat.
scheduled_jobs.name: notification_escalation

scheduled_jobs.description: One digest notification per user with unread notifications.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Deduped per calendar day via a deterministic source_event_id.
scheduled_jobs.name: daily_digest

scheduled_jobs.description: 'Starts tomorrow' reminder to each responsible person for every planned activity (incl. non-school programme events).
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Deduped per activity per day via a deterministic source_event_id.
scheduled_jobs.name: activity_reminders

scheduled_jobs.description: Rebuilds TargetAchievementLedger for every active CCEO/PL so My Targets/Team Targets/CD Analytics never show a stale ledger between page visits (the audit's 'ledger staleness' finding).
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: TargetAchievementService.rebuild() is get_or_create per (user, area, source) — safe to re-run.
scheduled_jobs.name: target_ledger_sync

scheduled_jobs.description: Sends due Professional Development pre-course/in-progress/overdue reminders.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: ProfessionalDevelopmentReminderLog uniqueness on (request, key, day) blocks double-sends.
scheduled_jobs.name: pd_reminders

scheduled_jobs.description: Closes delegated school actions whose underlying condition has cleared, and marks past-due ones overdue.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Resolution re-reads the source condition, so a second run finds nothing left to close; overdue marking is a state filter that excludes rows already OVERDUE.
scheduled_jobs.name: school_action_sweep

scheduled_jobs.description: Re-notifies the RVP about CD escalations past their severity SLA.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Re-notification is intentionally repeated daily while an escalation stays overdue; resolving it stops the sweep.
scheduled_jobs.name: escalation_sla_sweep

scheduled_jobs.description: Scans recent Field Debriefs for recurring cross-team/cross-country issues.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: RecurringIssueDetectionService.scan() updates the existing open insight instead of duplicating.
scheduled_jobs.name: field_debrief_recurring_issues

scheduled_jobs.description: End-of-day (and next-morning catch-up) reminders for field staff with scheduled activities but no Daily Debrief.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: WorkflowNotificationService dedupes on (recipient, event, context), so a rerun cannot double-notify the same user-date.
scheduled_jobs.name: daily_debrief_reminders

scheduled_jobs.description: Generates Monday-morning PL Weekly Team Debrief Report drafts for the closed Mon-Sun week.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Draft reports regenerate in place; finalized reports are never overwritten (a rerun creates a new version only when data changed and the owner regenerates).
scheduled_jobs.name: weekly_debrief_reports

scheduled_jobs.description: Delivers due user-configured analytics CSV digests by email.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Due rows are atomically claimed by advancing next_run_at before network delivery.
scheduled_jobs.name: analytics_report_delivery

scheduled_jobs.description: Ensures the Oct-Sep fiscal year has fresh priority cycles and draft agreements while preserving prior-year history.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: hr.FiscalYearRollover is unique by FY; completed reruns are read-only.
scheduled_jobs.name: fiscal_year_rollover

scheduled_jobs.description: Daily performance-cycle readiness; notifies HR 7 days before quarter end.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Read-only report; the 7-day notification dedupes per condition via the canonical trigger.
scheduled_jobs.name: performance_readiness

scheduled_jobs.description: Deletes spent second-factor challenges past their retention window.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: A delete of already-dead rows; re-running finds nothing left to do.
scheduled_jobs.name: mfa_challenge_purge

scheduled_jobs.description: Drafts next week's proposed schedule for every active CCEO — the platform prepares; staff accept or adjust (roadmap Phase 4).
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Regeneration supersedes the previous live draft (one live proposal per person-week, DB-enforced); accepted weeks are skipped — a re-run converges on the same drafts.
scheduled_jobs.name: autopilot_weekly_proposals

scheduled_jobs.description: Drains due durable-outbox events to their handlers with per-event retry, backoff and dead-lettering.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Claims use SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and handlers are idempotent by registry contract — overlapping or repeated drains converge on the same delivered state.
scheduled_jobs.name: outbox_drain

scheduled_jobs.description: Proposes duplicate-school candidates, then reconciles every operating school's data-quality issues (coordinates, ownership, clustering, SSA) as durable, self-closing queues.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Issues reconcile on condition_key (open rows update or resolve, never duplicate) and duplicate pairs are unique per (school, candidate) — a re-run converges to the same state.
scheduled_jobs.name: data_quality_scan

scheduled_jobs.description: Sessionises yesterday's interaction events into per-person-day aggregates for the Staff Time Standard and prunes raw events past retention.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: update_or_create keyed on (user_id, day) recomputed from the same raw events — a re-run rewrites identical rows.
scheduled_jobs.name: interaction_rollup

scheduled_jobs.description: Activates effective documents, expires lapsed ones, retries failed previews, sends acknowledgement reminders and closes idle viewer sessions.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Every step is a no-op when there is nothing due; reminders are deduplicated on last_reminded_at, so a second run the same day sends nothing.
scheduled_jobs.name: document_lifecycle

scheduled_jobs.description: Materialises due MaintenanceTemplates into scheduled Admin work items.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: next_due_date advances only after its work item is created, so a crashed run resumes and a completed run finds nothing due.
scheduled_jobs.name: admin_maintenance_generation

scheduled_jobs.description: Notifies Admins when a scheduled job has failed, never run or gone overdue, and closes the notice when it recovers.
scheduled_jobs.idempotency_note: Notifications are keyed on (event, scheduled_job, job name), so a job that stays broken re-fires into the notice already open rather than adding one every half hour.
scheduled_jobs.name: scheduler_watchdog
